## Problem

<!-- What problem does this feature solve? What is currently painful or
     impossible to do? Be specific — link to any existing bug report or
     discussion if relevant. -->

## Proposed Solution

<!-- Describe what you would like to see happen. Include any UI mockups,
     API shape, or expected behavior. -->

## Alternatives Considered

<!-- What other ways could this problem be solved? Why are they worse? -->

## Scope

- Does this require a database schema change? (yes / no / unsure)
- Does this require a new API endpoint? (yes / no / unsure)
- Does this require a new third-party dependency? (yes / no / unsure)
  If yes, why can an existing dependency not do the job?
- Is this security-sensitive? (yes / no)

## Who Benefits

<!-- Which users does this help — anonymous inbox users, Account Mode users,
     admins, all of the above? -->

## Additional Context

<!-- Screenshots, links to similar features in other products, related
     issues, etc. -->

## Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I am willing to open a PR for this feature if a maintainer agrees it
      is in scope.
- [ ] I am willing to help test a PR for this feature.
- [ ] I am only requesting the feature and cannot contribute code.
